babadag.title: Babadağ Mountain — A Paragliding Legend
babadag.desc1: Rising to 1,960 metres above the turquoise waters of Ölüdeniz, Babadağ is not just a mountain — it's the heartbeat of one of the world's greatest paragliding destinations.
babadag.desc2: With four separate launch points ranging from 1,200m to 1,900m, Babadağ caters to every level — from nervous first-timers to world-class acro and XC pilots.

about.title: About Ceyhun Aksoy — Ölüdeniz Paragliding Pilot
about.subtitle: 25+ years flying tandem paragliding from Babadağ over the Blue Lagoon.
about.storyText: My name is Ceyhun Aksoy. I have been flying tandem paragliding in Ölüdeniz since 1999 — one of the earliest pilots to fly from Babadağ Mountain commercially. Over the past 25+ years I have completed more than 50,000 tandem flights, carrying passengers from over 60 countries safely above the Blue Lagoon.
about.missionText: I hold a Turkish Civil Aviation Authority (SHGM) certified tandem paragliding licence and follow strict annual safety and equipment checks. My goal for every flight is simple: give you the most breathtaking, safest experience of your life.
about.certifiedDesc: All our pilots hold international BHPA/DHV certifications and annual safety reviews.
about.safetyDesc: Immaculate safety record across thousands of tandem flights.
